cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Hand me the hall key and tell everyone I'm now in charge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I just give you the key? My retirement taxi's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. The door will understand. The committee needs words.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're outside asking me whether to cancel Saturday's dance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I decide whether it goes ahead. Then ask me, in front of them. Your taxi can be my first approval.
